item.title: Coal India Ramps Up Solar Capex, Surpasses FY26 Target With Rs 961 Cr Spend
item.description: Coal India Limited (CIL) has recently shifted focus to scaling up its solar power capacity addition, as an alternative green energy source. After falling well behind the targets it set itself in 2020-21, the new shift is a welcome move from the largest coal miner in the world. item.title: Goa Issues 6-Hr Solar+BESS Tender for 300 MW Solar, 900 MWh BESS Project
item.description: The Goa Energy Development Agency (GEDA) has recently issued a Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) tender to select solar power developers for setting up a 300 MW solar project with a 150 MW/900 MWh Energy Storage System (ESS). Bids have been invited until March 6, 2026. item.title: Vaikom Becomes India’s First Fully Solar-Powered, Energy-Neutral Boat Station
item.description: Vaikom, located along the Vembanad backwaters, is preparing to transition into India’s first fully energy-neutral boat station. The initiative involves shifting both boat services and station-level operations entirely to solar power, removing diesel use from the jetty ecosystem. The development aligns with Kerala’s ongoing efforts to integrate renewable energy into public transport infrastructure and promote cleaner mobility solutions. item.title: ReNew Energy Q3 Results- Total Income Up 48%, A Return To Profitability Imminent
item.description: ReNew Energy Global Plc has announced its unaudited consolidated IFRS results for Q3 FY26 and nine months ended December 31, 2025. item.description: The Philippines’ Department of Energy (DOE) is advancing a long-term Green Energy Auction (GEA) pipeline that will add at least 25 GW of renewable capacity through annual competitive bidding rounds until 2035.
